a: You can’t ignore digivolution requirements when using this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into [Diaboromon] in the hand regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By deleting 1 of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name, this Digimon may digivolve into [Diaboromon] in the hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name is played, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
